ABOUT US

# Where DevOps teams come together to test smarter and faster

DevOps teams need to develop and release faster than ever before to meet the demands of today's consumers. The Sauce Labs Platform for Test helps DevOps teams evolve their testing and error monitoring processes so they can develop, update, and release market-leading web and mobile apps, faster.

[CONTACT US](https://saucelabs.com/contact-us)

AUTOMATED TESTING & ERROR MONITORING

## What is Sauce Labs?

Sauce Labs is the world's largest full-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium and other major test frameworks. Trusted by 80% of the world's top ten largest financial institutions, helping over 800 enterprise companies to safeguard the digital experience for their customers.

![Video Cover Poster](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a23c6059a4ce400627c8a99/6a5fbe5bead34a8c04cd17ce_video-player-cover-desktop.avif)

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

TEST. INTEGRATE. ACCELERATE.

## Why use Sauce Labs?

Today, every brand experience starts online, and delivering a seamless one comes down to working code, which ultimately comes down to efficient product testing. Yet testing hasn't kept pace with the speed of modern product releases. Development teams juggle multiple tools across the development lifecycle, creating silos, bottlenecks, and slower delivery.

Sauce Labs streamlines the entire testing process with one do-it-all service, boosting development speed without sacrificing product quality so you can improve user experience and grow your business.
